item.title: CENTCOM: U.S. Strikes Iranian Drone Carrier as Campaign Targets Navy
item.description: CENTCOM: U.S. forces aren’t holding back on the mission to sink the entire Iranian Navy. Today, an Iranian drone carrier, roughly the size of a WWII aircraft carrier, was struck and is now on fire.

item.title: Speaker Johnson: Operation Against Iran Is Limited, Not a War
item.description: Speaker Johnson after House blocked War Powers Resolution: “We’re not at war, we have no intention at being at war. The president and the Department of Defense have made it very clear, this is a limited operation.”

item.title: Newsom Criticizes Netanyahu Over West Bank Annexation Stance
item.description: Gavin Newsom on Netanyahu: I don’t like the direction he’s going…Particularly on the annexation of the West Bank. I can’t sit back…and watch that.

item.title: Newsom: Trump Presidency Will Be Over When Jeffries Gets the Gavel in 2026
item.description: Gavin Newsom: This is it for Trump. His presidency as we know it today is over in a matter of months, when Speaker Jeffries gets the gavel. Don’t talk about 2028. It’s not about 2028. It’s about 2026.

item.title: Watters: Liberal Media in ‘TDS Autopilot’ Over Operation Epic Fury
item.description: Jesse Watters: The liberal media is stuck on TDS autopilot. They can’t stop attacking the Trump administration over Epic Fury.

item.title: Judge Orders Trump Administration to Begin Refunding $130B in Tariffs, Appeals Expected
item.description: A judge on the U.S. Court of International Trade has ordered the Trump administration to begin the process of refunding more than $130 billion in tariffs collected under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), following the Supreme Court’s February 2026 ruling striking down the tariffs. The Trump administration is expected to appeal.
